s: Which was the central location of the trade centre in medieval Andhra?
x:
Penugonda was one of the most important commercial centres of medieval Andhra. It occupied a strategic position connecting the coastal ports with the inland regions. The town was famous for merchant guilds such as the Ayyavole-500 and Manigramam, which carried on extensive inland and overseas trade. It also emerged as an important centre of the Komati merchant community.
Hence, the correct answer is
Option (3).
